description: Search for a symbol by name across the entire workspace. Returns matching symbols with name, kind, file, and location. Use when you know a symbol's name but not its file. Use detail_level: "hover" to also get type signatures and docs for each match.

detail_level.description: Enrichment level: 'basic' for names/locations only, 'hover' to include type signatures and docs

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to enrich with hover info (default 3)

offset.description: Number of symbols to skip before enriching (default 0), for pagination

query.description: Symbol name or pattern to search for across the workspace

name: find_symbol
